name: Square Payments
summary: Square Payments processes cards, digital wallets and ACH bank transfers for in-person and online sales with no fee until a payment is taken. Card-in-person rates run from 2.4% to 2.6% plus 15 cents depending on the Square plan, and online API payments cost 2.9% plus 30 cents. Funds go to a bank account in batches, and sellers can pay for an instant deposit.

facts.text: The Web Payments SDK takes credit cards, gift cards, digital wallets (including Apple Pay and Google Pay), ACH bank transfers, Afterpay and Cash App Pay.
Risk Manager lets a seller create rules, blocks and alerts, including a rule that requires 3D Secure for payments that meet chosen conditions.
Instant Deposit moves funds to a linked bank account or debit card within seconds for a service fee, in the US, UK, Canada and Australia.
For US sellers the payout cutoff is 5 PM Pacific on each business day, so the dashboard balance for a day can differ from the funds in the bank account.
Manually entered cards and cards on file cost 3.5% plus 15 cents on every plan, and Afterpay costs 6% plus 30 cents.

hiddenCosts: Manually entered cards and cards on file cost 3.5% plus 15 cents on every plan.
Square's Plus and Premium plans change the processing rates, and the monthly price of those plans was not on the fees page we checked.
Instant Deposit carries a service fee that the pages we checked do not state.
